rules.rationale: Defines the named integer-projection definedness predicate as the existing isInt test.
Defines the named string-projection definedness predicate as the existing isStrV test.
Adds an unproved simplification characterizing the definedness of the existing Val-to-Int partial cast; it is not a definition of a new proof helper.
Adds an unproved simplification characterizing the definedness of the existing Val-to-Str partial cast; it is not a definition of a new proof helper.
Defines the guarded total integer projection helper by the existing partial cast.
Supplies the symbolic orientation of the same guarded definitional equation for the named total integer projection.
Defines the integer-subsort collapse case of the total integer projection helper.
Defines the guarded total string projection helper by the existing partial cast.
Supplies the symbolic orientation of the same guarded definitional equation for the named total string projection.
Defines the string-subsort collapse case of the total string projection helper.
Defines codesOf on the string-value constructor by exposing its code sequence.
Defines codesProject as composition of the named string projection and codesOf helpers.
Adds an unproved simplification extending existing str builtin dispatch from a statically typed integer to a guarded Val.
Adds an unproved simplification extending existing string-addition dispatch from a statically typed string to a guarded Val.
Defines the allowedOperator proof predicate by an explicit finite disjunction of operator encodings.
Defines the productive recursive case of the validAlgebraLists input-domain predicate.
Defines the total default case of validAlgebraLists as false.
Defines the terminal case of the mutually recursive validAlgebraRest predicate.
Defines the productive recursive case of validAlgebraRest using allowedOperator and validAlgebraLists.
Defines the total default case of validAlgebraRest as false.
Defines the no-number-list base case of the runPairCodes mathematical summary.
Defines the no-operator-list base case of the runPairCodes mathematical summary.
Defines the recursive accumulator equation for the runPairCodes mathematical summary.
Defines the singleton-number base case of the lastPairValue proof summary.
Defines the guarded recursive equation for the lastPairValue proof summary.
Defines the total fallback value of the lastPairValue proof summary.
